The cashier-sheet image is a small (~380 px) centred card whose caption "The cashier sheet on the live demo till." aligns to the image edge (x≈528) rather than the text column, with wide empty bands either side. The payment screen two shots earlier is full column width with its caption on the text column. The docs overview Next steps grid also ends with a short last row.

C6.worst_defect: On phone, dense inline code pills in running prose ("APP_ENV", "dev", "CORS_ORIGINS", "apiOptions", "vendure-config.ts" in one paragraph) push lines apart unevenly, so the paragraph's line spacing goes ragged. The stacked tax-table cards repeat the "Channel pricing:" label on every card.

C7.worst_defect: The OG card crops the till screenshot at the bottom edge mid product row, cutting the In Stock badges in half.

overall_worst.defect: Inline code pills are overused in running prose. Config and permission names ("APP_ENV", "CORS_ORIGINS", "apiOptions", "vendure-config.ts"; TallyPosSell, ReadCatalog, ReadSettings, ReadCustomer, CreateCustomer, ReadOrder…) render as bordered, padded pills that stack up in a paragraph, break its even line height and make the docs look noisy, worst on phone.
overall_worst.fix: Move permission sets and config names out of sentences into a bulleted list or small table, defined once and linked from the other pages. Give inline code in prose a lighter style (monospace with a faint tint, no border, minimal padding) so it sits on the text line without changing line height.
